Prakash Raj claims voter list deletion amid Karnataka SIR

Actor Prakash Raj stated his name was deleted from the Bengaluru electoral rolls during the ongoing Special Summary Revision (SSR) process. He claimed this deletion occurred under the SSR, suggesting a potential loss of voting rights. However, the Bengaluru civic body later clarified that Prakash Raj's name has not been deleted from the electoral roll. The Pioneer also linked this voter row to a surge in big-ticket micro loans.
